image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image captures the anterior to mid-section of the fish, showing the characteristic black head and front body transitioning into a bright yellow posterior. The eye is visible on the far left edge, and the dorsal and anal fins are partially visible along the top and bottom edges.
